highlights: ideal first investors, families and first time buyers
description:
Offering great potential, this home is spacious throughout and available with no onward chain. This property has the benefit of garage, private courtyard and is in a convenient setting within easy reach to Aycliffe town centre. Ideal for first time buyers, families and investors, this property offers potential to improve and refurbish further. The private courtyard is L-shaped with two entry gates and gives access to the main house. The property is entered via hallway which gives access to the main accommodation. There is also a downstairs w/c. The kitchen to the front is a good size and has dining area and door leading back to the courtyard. The living room is again a good size and has French doors to the side of the property. To the first floor the landing gives access to three bedrooms and the bathroom. The main bedroom is a double room and has sliding door wardrobes, the second bedroom is a double and the third is a good sized single. The bathroom is fitted with three piece suite. Outside the property is accessed via L-shaped courtyard which has two entry gates and is enclosed by fencing with paved area, steps and raised borders. There is a personal door to the garage which is accessed from the side of the property. The property can also be accessed via French doors to the side which open into the living room.

HALLWAY With two storage cupboards and staircase to the first floor.

DOWNSTAIRS W/C With window to the front, sink and w/c.

LIVING ROOM Situated to the rear, with fireplace and French doors to the side of the property.

KITCHEN/DINING ROOM With dining area and kitchen area comprising fitted units, worktops, tiled splashbacks, sink, space for appliances and door and window to the front.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING Access to the upstairs accommodation and storage cupboard.

BEDROOM ONE Double room with sliding door wardrobes and window to the side.

BEDROOM TWO Further double room with window to the front.

BEDROOM THREE Single room with window to the side.

BATHROOM Fully tiled with window to the front and fitted with suite comprising bath, w/c and wall mounted sink.

EXTERNALLY The property is accessed via L-shaped courtyard which has two entry gates and is enclosed by fencing with paved area, steps and raised borders. There is a personal door to the garage which is accessed from the side of the property. The property can also be accessed via French doors to the side which open into the living room.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
